title: The Cold Motor Engine
description:
Witness B: 'I just drove my motor car 50 miles at high speed, arriving at 9:00 PM.'
Detective Inspection at 9:02 PM: The motor car engine block is freezing cold.
question: Which witness is lying?
acceptable_answer_format:
Type only the witness name.

Example:
Witness B
hints: Driving 50 miles leaves the engine block hot, not freezing cold.
solution_explanation: Driving a car 50 miles at high speed leaves the engine block hot. Witness B's freezing cold engine proves he lied.
